reproFailure: Before the renderer fix the new test failed with: expected '- **Supply chain:** 0 (critical: 0, h...' to contain 'not measured'. Nine plants (failed audit read as 0, zero-dependency report accepted, audit exits non-zero on vulnerabilities, 0 for zero lockfiles, partial sum, snapshot fallback, hook ignoring the sidecar, push step blind to an untracked sidecar, audit step removed) each turned the suite red.
rootCause: The issue's root-lockfile theory is not the cause. Harness CLI 13.0.0 calls timelineManager.capture(result, commitHash) with no supply-chain argument, so capture() falls back to EMPTY_SUPPLY_CHAIN: no audit runs at all, with or without a root lockfile. The renderer then printed that field as a measurement.
closingKeywordWhy: The ledger line becomes truthful: it reads the audit of every tracked lockfile, and 'not measured' when none was audited or any failed. The harness collector stays as it is; that belongs upstream (harness-engineering#2082).
assumptions: DECIDED (human): a separate workflow step audits every tracked lockfile; 'not measured' when nothing was audited; timeline.json is not written to.

The result travels as a committed sidecar, .harness/security/supply-chain.json, because the freshness guard reruns the renderer with no audit. Without a committed input the guard would fail or the ledger would lose the count.
One failed lockfile makes the whole line 'not measured'. A partial sum would read as the repo's count. The sidecar keeps the per-lockfile numbers.
A report over zero dependencies counts as failed, because it is an abstention rather than a clean audit.
A tracked non-npm lockfile reads 'not measured' and is named, rather than silently shrinking the denominator. None is tracked today.
Totals are summed per lockfile, as the issue asks, so one advisory in two lockfiles counts twice.
The per-snapshot Supply column is removed: it only ever printed harness's unpopulated field, and no audit history exists to fill it.
The audit step runs on PRs as well as main, so a broken step shows up before merge. Only main's result is uploaded.

.harness/.gitignore gains an exception for the sidecar: it ignores security/* except named files, so the ledger job's git add would otherwise refuse it. Only reading the diff against the real repo found this; a test now pins it, in case a harness rescaffold drops the line.

docs/SECURITY_LEDGER.md is regenerated in this PR because the freshness guard requires it. No sidecar is committed here, so the line reads 'not measured' until the first scan on main lands through chore/security-ledger.
